utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated] Yes. Madam Registrar, you may proceed with calling the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. This is the case number, IT-99-36-T, the Prosecutor versus Radoslav Brdjanin and Momir Talic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated] Thank you. Mr. Brdjanin, good afternoon to you. Good afternoon to you. Can you hear me in a language that you can understand? THE ACCUSED BRDJANIN: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Yes, I can. I can hear you and understand you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Good afternoon to you. General Talic, good afternoon to you. Can you hear me in a language that you can understand? THE ACCUSED TALIC: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Yes, I can hear you in a language I understand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. You may sit down. Appearances for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. RICHTEROVA
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. Anna Richterova and Julian Nicholls for the Prosecution, assisted by Hasan Younis.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Good afternoon to you. Appearances for Radoslav Brdjanin.

utterances.speaker: MR. ACKERMAN
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. I'm John Ackerman with Milan Trbojevic and Marela Jevtovic for Mr. Brdjanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you. And good afternoon to you. Appearances for General Talic.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. Slobodan Zecevic and Natasha Ivanovic-Fauveau for General Talic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you. Good afternoon to you. So -- by the way, Mr. Ackerman and Mr. Zecevic, the small, slight problem that you mentioned yesterday has to my information been solved. And henceforth when we are working in this courtroom, there shouldn't be any further problems. So --

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: We appreciate that very much;, Your Honours. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: You're welcome. You're always welcome. So the next witness -- before we start with the next witness, are there any preliminaries? No. The next witness is a protected witness. We will be in closed session, so we'll go into closed session now and bring down the curtains.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
